messages:
Priya Rao: FYI EdgeLedger (EdgeCost) sent our renewal quote. There's a new 'priority routing' line and list prices are up ~18%.
Ben Carter: Oof. paste the quote lines?
Priya Rao: pasted:
```
EdgeCost Renewal Q1 2026
- Enterprise base: $22,500/mo
- Priority routing add-on: $4,050/mo
- Embedding overage: $0.0025 per embedding
- Annual discount: none quoted (term 12m)
```
Maya Liu: Didn't we have a 10% renewal credit last year for a 12m commit?
Priya Rao: yes. Contract EC-RED-2025 shows $240k commit with 10% applied. This quote removes that.
Jonah Park: @billing-bot confirm last year's committed spend and net invoiced amount.
billing-bot: Contract EC-RED-2025: committed ARR $240,000; renewal credit 10% applied. Net invoiced (2025) = $216,000.
Ben Carter: Action items: 1) Procurement to push for reinstated 10% or multi-year pricing; 2) Ops to ask for justification/metrics for the new addon; 3) Finance to extract month-by-month embedding counts for last 6 months.
Maya Liu: Also request a month-level breakdown so we can model overage risk.
Priya Rao: Can someone draft the renewal inquiry? Need: line-item justification for priority routing, usage tieout, renewal discount options, and a 30-day pricing hold while we reconcile.
Ben Carter: Draft below, will send once reviewed:
```
Subject: EdgeCost  renewal questions and pricing hold request

Hi EdgeCost team,

We received the renewal for EC-RED-2026 and need clarification before proceeding:
1) Please provide a line-item explanation for the new "priority routing" charge and the billing metric used.
2) Provide monthly embedding API usage for the last 6 months (counts per month) to validate overage calculations.
3) Confirm available renewal discounts for 12- or 24-month commitments and any migration/feature credits.
4) Please place the quoted pricing on a 30-day hold while we reconcile usage and contract terms.

We will not approve an auto-renewal with the addon enabled without explicit written acceptance.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
On behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Jonah Park: Add: if they won't reinstate discount, request a 6-month no-charge trial of the addon or a proportional credit.
Ben Carter: added. Sending now, cc procurement@redwood and priya.
Priya Rao: @billing-bot attach contract and last invoice to our thread.
billing-bot: Attached: contract_EC-RED-2025.pdf, invoice_2025-12.pdf :white_check_mark:
Maya Liu: Quick calc: Listed annual with addon = (22,500 + 4,050) * 12 = $318,600, ~47% above our net last year. Not acceptable.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Target asks: reinstate 10% + remove addon, or keep addon but apply at least 20% discount on total.
Ben Carter: Will post EdgeCost reply here when it comes in.
Priya Rao: Thanks all :thumbsup:
